segments.label: DELETE
segments.text:
Be helpful and professional.
Don't make mistakes.
Don't be too long.

segments.label: KEEP
segments.text:
I'm a [role] at [org].
My readers are [who],
who need [what].

segments.label: ADD
segments.text:
Answer first, because my
manager reads on her phone.
[UK] spelling, plain English.

segments.label: ADD
segments.text:
Ask before sending, posting
or deleting anything.
If you can't check it, say so.
End with five lines: what,
where, what to check.
